The business is FICTIONAL and INDEPENDENT: it is not Linear, not Stripe, and not Millwright (Phase 9/10's customer) reworded. Different market, different modules, different proof facts, different conversion.
goal: We are launching the marketing site for Switchyard, a B2B AI workflow automation company for freight brokerages and regional trucking carriers. We sell to dispatch managers, operations directors and carrier-relations leads at brokerages moving 200 to 5,000 loads a week who are still running their day out of an inbox, a load board and a spreadsheet. The site has to explain, plainly and without hype, that Switchyard reads the email, the EDI and the tracking feed, turns every load into one live lane plan, and tells a dispatcher what to do next before a load goes late — and every page has to end by asking the reader to book a dispatch review with our team.
category: AI workflow automation for freight brokerages and regional carriers
audience: dispatch managers, operations directors and carrier-relations leads at freight brokerages and regional trucking carriers moving 200 to 5,000 loads a week
positioning: the dispatch workflow layer that keeps every load, carrier message and tracking update on one live lane plan

facts.value: Yard: models every lane, load and stop so the plan matches the actual freight
Inbox: reads carrier email, EDI and load-board replies and files them against the right load
Tracker: folds ELD, GPS and check-call updates into one arrival estimate per stop
Dispatch: tells a dispatcher which load needs a decision next, and why
Coverage: matches an open load to the carriers that actually run the lane
Record: keeps the paperwork, the rate confirmation and the proof of delivery on the load

Switchyard was founded in 2022 by a former night-shift dispatcher and a freight data engineer, and the company is based in Chattanooga, Tennessee.
Switchyard is certified to ISO 27001 for its cloud platform, and the certificate is available on request.
A typical Switchyard rollout is live on a first set of lanes in four weeks, including the TMS connection.
